description: This file defines the PHP class HTMLPurifier_Node_Text, representing text nodes in an HTML purification library. It includes properties for storing character data, whitespace status, and methods for constructing instances and converting to token pairs.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Node_Text
classes.description: A class representing text nodes within the HTMLPurifier library, capable of storing character data, whitespace status, and converting to token pairs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the text node with data and whitespace status, optionally setting line and column information.

methods.name: toTokenPair
methods.description: Converts the text node into a token pair, creating an HTMLPurifier_Token_Text object with the node's data and position info.
